name: Knowledge-Graph Embedding
problem_statement: Learn entity and relation representations from typed directed triples for relational link prediction.

normalization: Preserve all declared vertices, including isolated vertices.
Preserve direction; an undirected projection must be explicitly requested.
Declare the treatment of self-loops and parallel edges before execution; an adapter must reject unsupported cases.

problem_inputs.name: validation_triples
problem_inputs.description: Held-out triples, never used to fit embeddings.

required_outputs.name: training_summary
required_outputs.description: Model configuration, losses and split-aware ranking metrics.

solution_semantics.exactness: Approximate learned model; held-out ranking quality is evaluated separately from training loss.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Output identities refer to the normalized input; any multiplicities must follow the declared task.
solution_semantics.ordering: No output order or choice among equally valid optima is required unless specified by an input.

validation_rules: Training uses only declared training triples.
Filtered ranking evaluation declares which known positives are excluded.
edge_cases: Multiple relation types can connect the same entity pair.
Unseen entities require a declared inductive policy or explicit rejection.

correctness: Training uses only declared training triples.
Filtered ranking evaluation declares which known positives are excluded.
